email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. Your careers page takes expressions of interest for Site Engineer and asks for resumes at careers@byrnecivil.com, so I am introducing myself for a junior site engineer role.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation to the Central Coast or Hunter.

Your subdivision, road reconstruction, culvert and stormwater work for councils and developers is the kind of civil site work I want to build on. My site work so far was in the Philippines, so I would start at a junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for a junior site engineer opening?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I would like to ask whether Byrne Civil Group has room for a junior site engineer. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. I am writing to careers@byrnecivil.com because your careers page lists Site Engineer among the roles you take expressions of interest for and asks for resumes there.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site, material and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). Projects like your Marine Drive road reconstruction and Bulga culverts are the kind of work I want to learn on. I have not yet worked on an Australian site or on sewer and water mains, so I would be starting at a junior level.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation to the Central Coast or Hunter.
I've attached my resume and cover letter and would be glad to talk if a junior site role comes up.
